consequence.statement: Error messages now include the cluster URL rather than the full cluster object; no operational failure is stated.

original.statement: An error message now returns the cluster URL instead of the full cluster object.

decision.reason: [ev-cfdd6703f154] is a one-line bug-fix changelog entry saying only that an error message now contains the cluster URL instead of the full cluster object. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, and no default or behaviour that operators rely on changes. Only the content of an error message changes, so "none" (informational) fits. P2's guess that log parsing could be affected is not stated in the evidence.
